description: This file contains the main application class for a Spring Boot project, configured to run a PostgreSQL demo with JPA auditing enabled. It initializes the application, reads a datasource URL from properties, and logs it upon startup.

classes.name: PostgresDemoApplication
classes.description: Main class for the Spring Boot application, responsible for starting the application and logging the datasource URL after properties are set.

methods.name: logDatasourceUrl
methods.description: Logs the JDBC datasource URL after the application properties are initialized.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point of the application that launches the Spring Boot app.
